recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見兩群濾泡中心細胞混合：小至中型、核不規則有裂痕且深染的中心細胞（centrocyte），以及較大、核圓而染色質空泡狀、核仁貼近核膜的中心母細胞（centroblast），並有分裂像；中心母細胞偏多，需評估分級。
features: Mixture of small to medium cleaved cells (centrocytes) with angulated, irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
Numerous large non-cleaved cells (centroblasts) with round vesicular nuclei and one to three peripheral nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
No normal polarization or tingible-body macrophages evident in this field
describe_en: High-power section of a neoplastic follicle shows a mixture of centrocytes with angulated, cleaved nuclei and numerous large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli. A mitotic figure is present, and tingible-body macrophages or polarization are not evident. The centroblasts appear relatively numerous in this field, so counting across multiple follicles is needed for grading. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma; correlation with architecture and BCL2/CD10 immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive centers show polarization into dark and light zones, abundant tingible-body macrophages, high Ki-67 and BCL2-negative germinal center cells.
DLBCL consists of diffuse sheets of large cells without a follicular architecture or CD21-positive FDC meshworks.
MCL is monotonous without centroblasts, and is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.
